prompt: Cohere's rerank-v4.0-pro is priced at $0.0025 per query in the sheet. What do 400 queries a day cost over 30 days, in dollars?

choices.text: Return the documents' full text
choices.why: Rerankers return indexes and scores.

choices.text: Match 'money back' to 'refunds' with no word in common
choices.why: Right. The stand-in counts words; a reranker reads meaning.

choices.text: Charge per token instead of per query
choices.why: The sheet prices it per query.

choices.text: Rank more than top_n documents
choices.why: top_n limits what is returned.
